title: Diver calls it the most important dive of his life
summary: Stefan Hogeborn tells of Diver calls it the most important dive of his life, about 2012 at Baltic Sea anomaly, between Sweden and Finland, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: >> That was probably the most important dive I've ever done in my life. I've done maybe 6,000 dives in my life.

plain: A diver named Stefan Hogeborn says that in 2012 he dived on the Baltic Sea anomaly, an odd-shaped object found on the seafloor between Sweden and Finland. He says that out of some 6,000 dives in his life, it was probably the most important, and he tells it on Jesse Michels' podcast in an episode about the treasure hunter who found it, a man named Dennis Asberg.
